metadata.title: Monochrome Boy Band Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of three young men in formal, dandy-inspired attire, posed in front of a classical architectural balcony. The composition is anchored by a large, elegant script title and a heraldic crest in the lower foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between the three subjects
Contrast between dark vests/trousers and light shirts
Integration of flowing script across the lower third of the frame
coreInvariants: Desaturated black and white color profile
Direct eye contact with the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned side-by-side, waist-up, filling the middle and upper horizontal bands of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large white script text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central figure outward to the flanking figures, then down to the script and crest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the subjects and architectural elements occupy most of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the vests and trousers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the shirts, script, and crest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between clothing layers.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script combined with a vector heraldic crest/shield icon.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, ornate swashes and high contrast.
Provides the necessary elegance and legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A black and white photo of three young men in formal vests and shirts standing in front of a white windowed balcony.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large white formal script title across the bottom third, overlapping the subjects' trousers, accompanied by a white ornate crest on the right.

verificationChecks: Does the script overlap the subjects?
Is the crest positioned in the lower right?

adjustableVariables: Specific style of formal attire (vests vs. jackets)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Proprietary logos or brand-specific crest details
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct male subjects
Verify script is white and centered
Ensure background is architectural and light-toned
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Trio Portrait + Formal Dandy Styling + Lower-Third Script Overlay + Heraldic Icon
